---
title: "Screenshot"
---

```{r include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

You can use `raylibr_screenshot()` to render a scene to an image.
It creates a hidden 400x300 window, draws on a black background, and returns the result.
The image auto-displays in knitr documents, just like ggplot2 plots.

```{r screenshot, message=FALSE}
library(raylibr)

raylibr_screenshot(function() {
  draw_circle(200L, 150L, 100.0, "yellow")
})
```
